mapper.select: SELECT xlbh, dlid, xlmc, isuse, yxxh, tmhgs, tmfs, sflbz, cjyq, zysx, sgys, clfdm, clfmc FROM gzsz_mx ORDER BY dlid, xlbh
SELECT xlbh, dlid, xlmc, isuse, yxxh, tmhgs, tmfs, sflbz, cjyq, zysx, sgys, clfdm, clfmc FROM gzsz_mx WHERE dlid = #{dlid} ORDER BY xlbh
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gzsz_mx (dlid, xlmc, isuse, yxxh, tmhgs, tmfs, sflbz, cjyq, zysx, sgys, clfdm, clfmc) VALUES (#{dlid}, #{xlmc}, #{isuse}, #{yxxh}, #{tmhgs}, #{tmfs}, #{sflbz}, #{cjyq}, #{zysx}, #{sgys}, #{clfdm}, #{clfmc})
mapper.update: UPDATE gzsz_mx SET clfdm=#{clfdm}, clfmc=#{clfmc} WHERE xlbh=#{xlbh}
UPDATE gzsz_mx SET clfdm=NULL, clfmc=NULL WHERE xlbh=#{xlbh}
UPDATE gzsz_mx SET clfdm=#{clfdm}, clfmc=#{clfmc} WHERE sgys=#{sgys}
mapper.select: SELECT m.xlbh, m.dlid, m.xlmc, m.clfdm, m.clfmc, m.sgys, z.dlmc FROM gzsz_mx m LEFT JOIN gzsz_zb z ON m.dlid = z.dlid WHERE m.clfdm IS NOT NULL AND m.clfdm != '' AND m.dlid = #{dlid} AND m.xlmc LIKE CONCAT('%', #{xlmc}, '%') ORDER BY m.dlid, m.xlbh
